info.description:
The course is designed to include the following contents:

Part 1: Introduction and Overview (Chapter 1)

+ Chapter 1: Globalization

Part 2: Country Differences (Chapter 2, 3, 4)

+ Chapter 2: International business environment: National Differences in Political Economy

+ Chapter 3: 
International business environment (cont.)
: 
Political Economy and Economic Development

+ Chapter 4: 
Differences in Culture

Part 3: The Global Trade and Investment Environment (Chapter 5, 6, 7, 8)

+ Chapter 5: International Trade Theories

+ Chapter 6: The Political Economy of International Trade

+ Chapter 7: Foreign Direct Investment

+ Chapter 8: Regional Economic Integration

Part 4: The Strategy of International Business (Chapter 9)

+ Chapter 9: Entry Strategy and Strategic Alliances
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Generalize components, characteristics, and features of the international business environment
Discover and predict leading trends and changes of the international business environment
Analyze entry strategies of international businesses and MNCs
Evaluate opportunities and challenges of the international business activities of enterprises and multi-national corporations (MNCs)
Compose reports on issues regarding the international business environment and entry strategies of international businesses and MNCs
